We partner with leading semiconductor and advanced device manufacturers to address complex challenges and develop solutions that facilitate next-generation technological innovations. With over 50 years of experience in systems engineering and material science, a global manufacturing footprint and major application labs across the world, we are well-positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities across various sectors including data centers, communications infrastructure, industrials, automotive, and consumer electronics.
